lessons.title: 15.1 Kinetic model
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain Kinetic model in the context of Molecular Theory of Gases.

Kinetic model is understood through physical models, laws, equations, units and experimental evidence. Interpret relevant diagrams and solve numerical examples with correct units.

**Study task:** Define key terms, explain the principle, identify an equation or diagram where relevant, and solve a textbook-style example.
